name: chat_react
description: Toggle an emoji reaction on a chat message. If you already reacted with that emoji, the reaction is removed (Slack-style toggle). Returns whether the reaction was added or removed.
llm_description: Toggle an emoji reaction on a chat message (Slack-style: same emoji again removes it). Input: {msg_id, emoji}. The message is identified by msg_id alone; there is no room. Returns whether added or removed.

emoji.description: Emoji name or character, e.g. "👍" or "thumbsup"
